question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India makes provisions for a joint sitting of both Houses of Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 108**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to Article 108 of the Indian constitution, the joint sitting of the Parliament is called by the President.
 
• It is presided over by the Speaker or, in his absence, by the Deputy Speaker&n
